chunks.text:
A Tensor is specified by an iterator and a layout:
$$L = S : D$$
where $S$ denotes the shape of the tensor, and $D$ denotes the strides of the tensor
For example:
row-major versus col-major
$$\begin{array}{ccc}
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|}
\hline
0 & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 & 5 \\
\hline
6 & 7 & 8 & 9 & 10 & 11 \\
\hline
12 & 13 & 14 & 15 & 16 & 17 \\
\hline
18 & 19 & 20 & 21 & 22 & 23 \\
\hline
\end{array}
&
\hspace{3em}
&
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|}
\hline
0 & 4 & 8 & 12 & 16 & 20 \\
\hline
1 & 5 & 9 & 13 & 17 & 21 \\
\hline
2 & 6 & 10 & 14 & 18 & 22 \\
\hline
3 & 7 & 11 & 15 & 19 & 23 \\
\hline
\end{array}
\\[1em]
L = (4,6) : (6,1) & & L = (4,6) : (1,4)
\end{array}$$
broadcast versus strides
\begin{array}{ccc}
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|}
\hline
0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\
\hline

\hline
\end{array}
\\[1em]
L = (4,6) : (6,1) & & L = (4,6) : (1,4)
\end{array}
broadcast versus strides
$$\begin{array}{ccc}
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|}
\hline
0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\
\hline
1 & 1 & 1 & 1 & 1 & 1 \\
\hline
2 & 2 & 2 & 2 & 2 & 2 \\
\hline
3 & 3 & 3 & 3 & 3 & 3 \\
\hline
\end{array}
&
\hspace{3em}
&
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|}
\hline
0 & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 & 5 \\
\hline
12 & 13 & 14 & 15 & 16 & 17 \\
\hline
24 & 25 & 26 & 27 & 28 & 29 \\
\hline
36 & 37 & 38 & 39 & 40 & 41 \\
\hline
\end{array}
\\[1em]
L = (4,6) : (1,0) & & L = (4,6) : (12,1)
\end{array}$$
